[ For infra & wallets ]

Support every EEZ chain with the stack you already run.

Chain ID, RPC, blocks, logs and receipts work like any EVM chain. Only cross-chain calls go through the composer.

What you can do

Serve users on EEZ chains

With the endpoints and methods you already run: chain ID, RPC, blocks, logs, receipts.

Cross-chain calls in one signature

Your users call another chain and get the answer in the same transaction, from your wallet.

Show the real user

Decode the proxy back to the person who signed, so activity reads the way they expect.

All use cases →

What it takes

By role.
  • Indexer or explorerAdd the chain ID and RPC. Standard block, log and receipt methods
    Works today
  • WalletPlain transfers work as on any EVM chain. Cross-chain calls are estimated and sent through the composer
    With changes
  • AA bundler or paymasterPlain user operations estimate normally. A cross-chain call is estimated and sent through the composer front
    With changes
  • Block builder or relayThe composer posts batches and decides what lands. Your inclusion path is scoped per builder
    With changes

Before you commit

Today's gaps by role.
vs
What you get

Works today

  • Chain ID and RPC, like any EVM chain
  • Standard block, log and receipt methods
  • Plain transfers and user operations estimate normally
  • A public explorer on each L2
Plan for these

In progress

  • Packaged follower node: coming. Run a deriver to rebuild the chain from L1 in the meantime
  • Cross-chain estimates come from the front. They cover only the source transaction
  • The caller is a proxy. Activity views must decode it back to the user

One question before we scope

Which role, and which chain. The scoper tells you what applies before you send anything.
